summary: Provides utility functions for resolving filesystem paths and managing allowed project configurations.
responsibilities: Normalize and resolve project file paths
Identify valid projects within a global configuration
Update or insert project entries in the configuration object
Generate default display names for project directories

symbols.name: resolveProjectPath
symbols.summary: Resolves the absolute path of the given CWD.

symbols.name: findAllowedProject
symbols.summary: Retrieves an AllowedProject object matching the path from the global config.

symbols.name: isProjectAllowed
symbols.summary: Checks if a project path exists in the allowed projects list.

symbols.name: defaultDisplayName
symbols.summary: Returns the basename of a path for display purposes.

symbols.name: upsertAllowedProject
symbols.summary: Adds or replaces a project entry within the global config.
